theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → UpperSemicontinuous (fun y : Euclid d => (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal)
